name: Amelia Coppuck Welby
bio: Amelia Coppuck Welby (1819–1852) was an American poet who wrote for the Louisville Journal and was popular in her day. Her verses were gathered in Poems by Amelia (1844).
The poem here is taken from Edmund Clarence Stedman’s An American Anthology, 1787–1900 (Boston and New York: Houghton, Mifflin and Company, 1900).

poems.title: Twilight at Sea
poems.author: Amelia Coppuck Welby
poems.text:
The twilight hours like birds flew by,
  As lightly and as free;
Ten thousand stars were in the sky,
  Ten thousand on the sea;
For every wave with dimpled face,
  That leaped upon the air,
Had caught a star in its embrace,
  And held it trembling there.
